    *   4 x 5 = 20. Now we need to add or subtract 2 and 3 to get 32.
    *   20 + 2 + 3 = 25 (Too low)

    *   20 + 2 - 3 = 19 (Too low)
    *   20 - 2 + 3 = 21 (Too low)

    * 10 + 3 + 4 = 17 (Too low)
